تستفهمين (form X)
# تَسْتَفْهِمِينَ (tastafhimīna) /tas.taf.hi.miː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَفْهَمَ (istafhama)
# تُسْتَفْهَمِينَ (tustafhamīna) /tus.taf.ha.miː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَفْهَمَ (istafhama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
